decision: The competitor (Audi Revolut F1 Team) is fined €7,500.
fact: Car 98 was released with a cooling fan still attached to the intake of the right radiator.
offence: Breach of Article B1.6.2b.i of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video evidence. The team representative explained that on noticing that the cooling fan was still attached, he checked with his engineers to ascertain if it was safe to continue the lap and was advised by them that it was. The team then instructed the driver to pit, and it was confirmed the driver was unaware of the issue. Although the fan did not fall off the car (as was the case of a car in Australia this year) there was the possibility it could have. Accordingly a penalty similar to that applied to Car 12 in Australia, was applied.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 98 Released In An Unsafe Condition
to: The Team Manager, Audi Revolut F1 Team
